source_instruction: i am looking for standard sized levi strauss & co. men's carpenter jeans that are machine washable.
query:
Hey, I swung by that little community park on my walk over here earlier and ended up stopping for almost 20 minutes to watch a group of retired folks run a tiny model sailboat regatta on the pond. One guy had a hand-built wooden sloop he’d spent three months carving, with tiny linen sails he’d stitched himself, and it kept zipping past all the store-bought plastic boats like they were standing still. A couple of kids who were there feeding ducks got so hyped up watching the races they started cheering every time that little wooden boat pulled ahead, and one of the retirees even let the smallest kid help him adjust the rudder before the next heat. It was such a nice, unplanned little moment that it almost made me late getting over to browse today.
I’m looking for men’s jeans in the standard fit, first off. I need them to be dry clean only, no exceptions, and I’d also like them to come with a removable utility cell phone pocket stitched to the right thigh. Can you show me all the options that fit what I’m looking for? I’ve got a pretty tight budget I’m sticking to for this, so don’t pull anything that goes over the amount I’m comfortable spending, yeah?
